the ³132V´        and issued a Subpoena to Meta commanding production of the following documents


by July 20, 2026:

       1.   Analyses, data, reports, calculations, and/or evidence which demonstrate the level of
            investment and permanent job creation expected to be entailed by the Richland Data
            Center.

Immediate Review of Interlocutory Ruling and Motion to Quash.

protective orders. The burden to demonstrate good cause rests with the party seeking protection

          Further, there is particular concern in providing this information to the NPO parties seeking

the   Subpoena. The NPOs participate in utility dockets across the United States and actively

projects, it believes that a stay of the information demanded in the Subpoena is necessary to

minimize any consequential hardship that may arise if the information is released to the public or


used against it in other state utility proceedings given its significant economic value.
